name: install_svn
title: Install a package from a SVN repository

origin.description: Check out a Subversion repository and install it with R CMD INSTALL.
origin.usage: install_svn(url, subdir = NULL, args = character(0), revision = NULL, dependencies = NA, quiet = FALSE, ...)

arguments.name: revision
arguments.text: Revision passed to svn checkout as -r.
Further arguments are passed to install.packages. lib is the library directory and is accepted.

origin.details: svn must be on PATH. When it is missing, the error names the package as unknown because the package name is also read with svn.
origin.value: The package name. An error when svn is not installed.
origin.example: install_svn("https://example.invalid/repo", dependencies = FALSE, upgrade = "never", quiet = TRUE, lib = lib)

translation.description: Check out a Subversion repository and install it with R CMD INSTALL.
translation.usage: install_svn(url, subdir=None, args=None, revision=None, dependencies=NA, quiet=False, lib=None)

arguments.text: Further arguments are passed to install.packages. lib is the library directory and is accepted.

translation.details: svn is located with shutil.which. A missing client raises the same wrapped error as remotes.
translation.value: The package name. InstallError when svn is not installed.
